svg.text: Figure 7.5. The GATHER engine's datapath: the request queue, the start address, the k reads and their tokens
v1.0 (spec/machine-spec.md §4.4, §4.5, §4.13) — one tile; gathers are local only
A. The datapath (§4.4): one request at a time, k reads per request, one read offered per cycle
from the traffic director (figure 5.1): mode 1 accepted
the ordinal, 20 bits; the key half
load = valid & ¬active: the head's start is computed this cycle,
addr register ← start, i ← 0, active ← 1; the first read goes next cycle.
offer = active. On taken: addr += 2, i += 1, and a token is pushed.
last = active & taken & (i = k − 1): pop the queue, active ← 0.
So consecutive requests have a one-cycle gap between their reads.
and the read port; offer / taken
to the return path (token FIFO, item 8):
the value goes out as a mode-2 packet
Reads issued but not landed are not included:
B. Two requests, k = 2, cycle by cycle: base B, ordinals 5 and 9; every read taken
t: ordinal 5 reaches the head; start = B + 2·2·5 = B + 20 is computed and loaded. t+1, t+2: the two reads, each taken, each pushing a token; the second pops.
t+3: ordinal 9 at the head, start B + 36; its reads at t+4 and t+5. Each value costs about k + 1 cycles through the injection point anyway (§4.4's rate), so the gap costs nothing.
a mode-1 packet accepted this cycle; payload[51:32]
the value size in records, k = 1–8
the value buffer's start in a gather run (one base per run, v1.0)
the read was accepted this cycle
dst = me, mode 2, addr 0: the value lands at PTR[me], += 2 (figure 5.1)
push & full: the request is dropped
queue not empty, or a request part-way through its k reads

• Back-pressure is implicit (§4.4): the address generator gets a turn in the SRAM read queue only when no gather value is waiting, so its index reads stop while requests queue, and the queue holds at most
what was in flight. A tile's own sources cannot overflow it [meas: meshsim]: condition 8 means a fault.
• Counting is not here: mode-1 requests are not counted, and the gather values count down DMA_SRAM_REMAINING as any mode-2 arrival does (n values: n·k).

• × k for k = 1–8 is a sum of at most three shifted copies of the 20-bit ordinal, so two adders (ordinal·k = the sum of ordinal << b over the set bits b of k; k = 8 is one shift). The product is taken mod
junction (crossings without a dot don't connect); wedge: clocked register
Each mode-1 request queues only its 20-bit ordinal. At the head, the start DMA_RECORD_BASE_ADDRESS + 2k·ordinal is computed and loaded; the k reads
follow, one offered per cycle at priority 1, each stepping the address by 2 and pushing a token that sends the value back to the tile as mode 2.
A push at full drops the request and sets condition 8; GATHER busy covers the queue and the request in progress.
